text:
Maya: Heads up: CI eval job (quant-bench/tenantA) leaked customer prompts into artifact s3 path. Found sample that contained customer PII.
Oliver: Thanks for flagging. Which job? Can you paste the artifact path?
Maya: s3://redwood-eval-artifacts/quant-bench/1799012345/run-42/samples.json
I grepped for an email regex and found customer@example.com inside `input_prompt`.
Devon: That should never be in a shared bucket. Was this test running with sandboxed tenant config? @EvalRunner any logs?
EvalRunner: job 1799012345 started on runner-7 with --shared-artifacts true due to old flag. Showing config:
```
runner:
  sandbox: false
  artifact_prefix: "quant-bench"
  per_tenant_namespace: null
```
I recommend per-tenant namespace enabled.
Maya: I pulled the object and redacted it locally. We should rotate any keys used by that run and purge the S3 object versions ASAP. @secops-bot?
secops-bot: Opened INC-2026. Temporary fix: restrict bucket list/get to internal CI role only and object lock lifecycle 1 day. Also need deletion of leaked file—requesting s3 delete markers. Filing keys rotation ticket.
Oliver: Long term: runner should write artifacts to per-tenant prefixes and optionally enable automatic redaction for any fields matching PII before upload. Also CI should fail if per_tenant_namespace is null for runs touching customer prompt sets.
Devon: Agree. Quick patch: change default --shared-artifacts to false and add validation in CI hook.
Patch idea:
```
if not config.per_tenant_namespace:
  raise RuntimeError("per_tenant_namespace must be set when using customer_prompts=true")
```
I'll open PR.
Maya: Also, our eval dashboards ingest samples for quality metrics. If samples are redacted, we need a white-listed hashing approach so metrics still compute. Suggest: replace PII tokens with stable hash tokens like __EMAIL_abc123__ so tokenization/metrics unchanged.
EvalRunner: We have a sanitizer module in eval-harness but it was bypassed by quant runner path. I can add sanitizer hook pre-upload. Code snippet:
```
from eval_harness.sanitizer import redact_pii
samples = redact_pii(samples, mode='hash')
upload(samples, prefix=per_tenant_namespace)
```
ci-bot: ci/test-quant-bench #1799 failed: isolation-check hook returned non-zero. Logs: "Missing per_tenant_namespace"
Oliver: Good, CI caught it after your commit? Which commit fixed it?
Devon: PR 4332 opened: enforce per_tenant_namespace, run sanitizer, and add e2e test. Waiting review. cc @Maya for QA steps.
Maya: QA: run local harness with a simulated tenant and check S3 keys, ensure no raw prompt strings. Command:
```
pytest tests/eval_runner/test_isolation.py::test_tenant_s3_prefix --run-local
```
Oliver: We should also add access controls to the eval UI and dashboards so only evaluators and platform infra can view raw prompts. Dashboard ingest path should store raw prompts in a kms-encrypted internal-only bucket and redact for other roles.
secops-bot: Security note: rotation of any API tokens used by CI within last 30 days. Also recommend enabling SSE-KMS on the artifact bucket with dedicated key and key policy restricting to infra roles.
Maya: Action items:
- Devon: PR 4332 + e2e test (ETA today)
- Oliver: Dashboard ingest gating + KMS config
- SecOps: purge leaked artifacts + rotate tokens (INC-2026)
- EvalRunner: add pre-upload sanitizer hook
I'll run a quick audit script to scan last 7 days of artifacts for PII.
Devon: On it. Adding unit tests for sanitizer patterns (emails, phone, SSNs) and fuzz tests on quant runner outputs since quantization changed tokenization sometimes leading to merged tokens that hide PII detection.
EvalRunner: Note: quantized model outputs can split PII across subword tokens; sanitizer needs to operate on decoded strings not token streams. Also ensure we don't accidentally hash unrelated tokens.
Maya: :thumbsup: Good point. Let's make sanitizer default to operate after detokenization and before metric ingestion.
ci-bot: Patch merged to staging. e2e isolation test added. Deploy started to staging by deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: deploy/staging/quant-runner v2.14.3 started by @Devon
Oliver: Follow-up: audit report in 24h; if any more leaks, we'll pause customer prompt runs by feature flag.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Filing retrospective note for postmortems channel.
